split.placement_rule: fixed explicit centers and dimensions; no random sampling

input_contract.ocr_input: only the fixed synthetic annotation and legend regions required to classify the arrow and legend; no marker or crossing labels
input_contract.axis_geometry: fixed oracle plot polygon; no fitting
input_contract.rendering: deterministic Gray8 black-on-white synthetic raster, allocated in memory
input_contract.marker_annotation: drawn marker pixels plus specified center; evaluation only
input_contract.prohibited_annotation: drawn crossing-center points and arrow, bracket, legend, and grid/cross pixels; evaluation only

candidate_identity.rule: unchanged outline-circle-cross-core-probability-v2; require long crossing plus >=15/16 annular sectors at a radius 4..9, then raise marker-like probability in existing 5x5 core
candidate_identity.implementation_source: tests/GraphReader.App.Tests/ArtifactMaskOutlineCoreCandidateTests.cs; private nested test-only provider loaded by reflection

bounded_improvement_requires: candidate must suppress fewer marker centers than baseline
candidate must not suppress more marker centers than baseline
candidate must not mask more marker truth pixels than baseline
candidate must not lose any clear-cross or grid crossing-center mask compared with baseline
candidate must not reduce mask coverage on arrow, bracket, or legend truth pixels
candidate must not reduce AnnotationArrow, Bracket, or LegendStructure region counts

limitations: This is synthetic component evidence using fixed oracle plot bounds, not a full production workflow or release acceptance.
Ground-truth geometry is drawn by the fixture and only used to score output; no OCR truth boxes are supplied.
Arrow and legend OCR regions are synthetic runtime context required for those categories, not marker labels.
